def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform horizontal stripes form the motif; fill missing rows by extending
    # the period of the known row-color sequence.
    known = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0]
    # Find the smallest repeating period supported by all given stripe clues.
    for p in range(1, h + 1):
        phase = {}
        valid = True
        for r, color in known:
            k = r % p
            if k in phase and phase[k] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            phase[k] = color
        if valid:
            # Fill the unobserved phases by nearest cyclic continuation from
            # the observed stripe rows when the period has unseen entries.
            if len(phase) == p:
                motif = [phase[k] for k in range(p)]
                return [[motif[r % p]] * w for r in range(h)]
    # Clues specify a non-periodic stripe sequence; extend from the closest
    # matching demonstrated stripe pattern, preferring previous stripe.
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r][0]:
            color = grid[r][0]
        else:
            prev = next((grid[j][0] for j in range(r-1, -1, -1) if grid[j][0]), None)
            nxt = next((grid[j][0] for j in range(r+1, h) if grid[j][0]), None)
            color = prev if prev is not None else nxt
        out.append([color]*w)
    return out
PY
